lines.text: @sai_front pedals across a busy bridge at rush hour, weaving past stopped cars, smiling under his helmet.

new_beats.text: Rush hour only stops the ones who let it.

writes.note: I added a short VO line over the ride and kept your action and direction as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot shows him moving while traffic is still, so the VO states that contrast in one short line without naming anyone or adding action.
